title: fix(rest)!: an async import job whose every row failed ends failed, not succeeded

_Requested by **Sales** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4Uu?thread=cmsg_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4UuPMZ8BHWtPf6nBTp51qSM64)_
Fixes #27676

domain:server#2 · os-sales · session_01L6bhgUCizoYWQVJWjhdR6F

Clause-②: no (narrowing)
Metadata-protocol: none
Skills-docs: none — no hand-written docs page or published skill states the async import job's terminal-status rule (`git grep` of `content/docs` outside `references/`/`releases/` and of `skills/` for the job status vocabulary: 0 hits; `import-mappings.mdx` documents per-row outcomes only). The `ImportJobStatus` docblock and the generated reference are the spec seat's card #27734.

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:后台导入作业(`POST /data/OBJ/import/jobs`)在未取消、有行、且没有任何一行被新建/更新/跳过时,终态记为 `failed`(原来是 `succeeded`),`error` 写一句话说明每行都失败、去看 `results`。
- 为什么改:按你的裁决 B(记录 6509036166):一行都没导入的作业不能对只看 `status` 的客户端说「成功」。
- 风险与回滚:只改这一种终态;部分失败、全部跳过、零行作业仍是 `succeeded`,取消仍优先;撤销不受影响(这种作业本来就不可撤销)。回滚即删掉 `data-action-routes.ts` 里的一个判断。
- 先看:`packages/rest/src/data-action-routes.ts` 里 `everyRowFailed` 那段;`packages/rest/src/import-job-integration.test.ts` 末尾新增的 describe;`packages/rest/src/import-row-cell-errors.test.ts` 的轮询期望。
- 两分钟验证:`pnpm --filter @objectstack/rest exec vitest run src/import-job-integration.test.ts`,预期 21/21 通过。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地。

## Ruling (binding)

Maintainer ruling B, record 6509036166 on #27676, execution parameters quoted:

> 1. **Predicate.** At the terminal-status line of the job worker (`packages/rest/src/data-action-routes.ts`, the `finalStatus` computation): `!cancelled && total > 0 && created + updated + skipped === 0` ⇒ `failed`, else today's rule. Not `ok === 0`: a skipped row is not counted in `ok`. `error` is set to one sentence saying every row failed and pointing at `results`, with no tracker number.
> 2. **Kept as `succeeded` on purpose:** a zero-row job, an all-skipped job, and a partly-failed job. The batch door's "any failure ⇒ false" rule is not carried over. Cancellation still wins.
> 3. **Dry-run:** the same rule (an all-error dry-run ends `failed`).
> 4. **Server PR** (`domain:server`, after #27501 (a) PR #27711 merges; same file), with five pins: all rows fail → `failed`, `errors === total`, `error` present; 2 ok + 1 fail → `succeeded` (the existing partial pin is unchanged); all skipped → `succeeded`; cancellation still wins; all-error dry-run → `failed`.
> 5. **Spec docblock** (`packages/spec/src/api/export.zod.ts`, the `ImportJobStatus` / `ImportJobProgressSchema.error` sentences, plus `gen:docs`) goes to the `domain:spec` seat as its own PR, not in the server PR.

## What changes

- `packages/rest/src/data-action-routes.ts`, the async import worker's terminal status. The existing cancel resolution runs first and is unchanged: `summary.cancelled`, then the in-memory `cancelledImportJobs` flag, then the durable row re-read. Only a status still `succeeded` after all three is tested by the new predicate, so a cancel always wins, including a late one.
- The predicate, mapped onto the runner's real summary (`ImportRunSummary extends ImportProgress`, `packages/core/src/utils/import-runner.ts`): ruling `cancelled` = the resolved status is not `cancelled` (`summary.cancelled` plus the two late re-checks); `total` = `summary.total` (`rows.length`); `created` / `updated` / `skipped` = `summary.created` / `summary.updated` / `summary.skipped`. `summary.ok` is not read: it counts created and updated rows only.
- When the predicate holds, the final patch writes `status: 'failed'` and `error`: "Every row of this import failed and nothing was imported; each row's reason is in the job's results." Counts, `results` and `completed_at` are written exactly as before. A dry run takes the same path (its valid rows count as created / updated in the runner's preview).
- No `packages/spec` change: the `ImportJobStatus` / `error` docblocks are #27734.
- Changeset: `@objectstack/rest` patch, BREAKING note, ADR-0087 `not-required (no-migration-prescription)` marker.

### Readers of `failed` vs `succeeded` in this lane, measured

- Undo (`importJobUndoable`, `rest-server.ts`): admits `succeeded` / `cancelled` only, and also needs a non-empty undo log. A job that created and updated nothing has an empty log, so it was not undoable before and is not now. Pinned: the all-failed job reads `undoable: false` and undo answers 422 `NOT_UNDOABLE`.
- Cancel route: acts on `pending` / `running` only; unaffected.
- History filter `?status=`: passes the string through; pinned that the all-failed job lists under `status=failed`.
- Console Import Wizard (`ImportWizard.tsx` `importResultOutcome`): already reads "nothing imported and something errored" as `failed`, and `jobStatus === 'failed'` as `failed`; the synthetic row at the `prog.status === 'failed'` branch fires only when no per-row error arrived, which this change never produces. `failed` is already in its closed terminal set. No UI change.

## Tests

`packages/rest/src/import-job-integration.test.ts`, a new describe on the file's harness (real `RestServer` route, real `ObjectQL` engine + `ObjectStackProtocolImplementation`, SQLite `:memory:`, real `sys_import_job`):

- every row fails → `failed`, `errors === total` (3), `error` present and naming `results`; `results` has 3 failed rows; nothing landed; `undoable: false`, undo 422 `NOT_UNDOABLE`; listed under `status=failed`.
- control: every row skipped (`writeMode: 'update'`, no match) → `succeeded`, no `error`.
- control: a header-only CSV (0 rows) → `succeeded`, no `error`.
- every row of a dry run fails → `failed`, `dryRun: true`.
- control: a valid dry run → `succeeded`.
- control: a cancel that lands after the last row of a job whose every row fails at the driver → `cancelled`, with `errors: 3` (it waits for the worker's own final write of `results` before reading).
- 2 ok + 1 fail → `succeeded`: the existing first case of the file, unchanged.

`packages/rest/src/import-row-cell-errors.test.ts`: its async poll helper asserted `succeeded` for every job; the two one-row jobs whose only row fails (`NO_NAME`) now expect `failed`, per the ruling. A stale fixture, a direct consequence of this change.

## Acceptance notes

- The pins drive the route handlers registered on a real `RestServer`, not an HTTP transport, the harness the file's existing cases use.
- The first full-suite run showed the late-cancel pin racing a fixed 50 ms wait under load (it read the cancel route's write before the worker's final patch); the pin now waits on the worker's `results` write instead. Re-run green in the full suite.
- The sync door (`POST /data/:object/import`) has no status and is untouched.

## Verification

Readings are at head `2fa11634` unless a line names another sha.

<details><summary>Red before the fix (e5363269, tests only)</summary>

```
× every row fails: the job ends failed, errors === total, and error is set
× every row of a dry run fails: the job ends failed
-   "status": "failed",
+   "status": "succeeded",
Tests  2 failed | 19 passed (21)
```
</details>

<details><summary>Ablations (scripts/ablation-replace.mjs; each restored blob == HEAD, `git diff HEAD` empty)</summary>

The suites import `./rest-server` from source, so no dist rebuild was involved.

1. Delete `if (everyRowFailed) finalStatus = 'failed';` → red: the two all-failed pins plus the two `import-row-cell-errors` polls (`Tests 4 failed | 23 passed (27)`).
2. Predicate spelled `summary.ok === 0` → red: "every row skipped keeps succeeded" (`expected "succeeded", received "failed"`).
3. Cancel guard spelled `!summary.cancelled` (ignoring the late re-checks) → red: the late-cancel control.
4. `&& summary.total > 0` deleted → red: "a job with no rows keeps succeeded". (A first attempt with an empty `--replacement` was refused by the tool before running anything; re-run with `--delete`.)
</details>

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/rest test`: lock VERDICT command-exit 0, 342/342 files, 6701 passed, 326 skipped.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/rest typecheck`: exit 0, 0 test-layer errors (at 138a6202; the commit after it touches two test files that the full suite above compiled and ran).
- `eslint packages/rest --no-inline-config`: exit 0.
- `dispatch-gates --commands`: 59 families derived; results in the os-dev-report on #27676. `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` exits 3 PREREQUISITE NOT MET (it reads every package's dist): NOT MEASURED locally, carried by CI `Lint & Repo Gates`.
- No open PR touches `data-action-routes.ts`, `import-job-integration.test.ts` or `import-row-cell-errors.test.ts` (REST read of all 35 open PRs' files).
- Dogfood battery (`(narrowing)` arm) at the final head `2c10836a`: os-verify-lock VERDICT exit 0 (held 31m29s), 355 files passed and 3 skipped (358), 2867 tests passed and 20 skipped (2887), no failures (os-dev-report 6512268257). An earlier run at `2fa11634` had 2 failures, both the stale dogfood poll in `packages/qa/dogfood/test/import-reference-exposure.dogfood.test.ts`, which `2c10836a` updates (it waited for `succeeded` on an all-rows-failed job); that file is added to the claim by amendment.
